mapper.select: SELECT user_id as userId, COUNT(*) as count FROM sign_in WHERE sign_in_date BETWEEN #{startOfMonth} AND #{endOfMonth} GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT u.user_id as userId, up.nickname as userName, COALESCE(sis.total_sign_ins, 0) as totalSignIns, COALESCE(sis.current_continuous_days, 0) as continuousDays, COALESCE(sis.max_continuous_days, 0) as maxContinuousDays, COALESCE(monthly.monthly_sign_ins, 0) as monthlySignIns, COALESCE(monthly.points_earned, 0) as pointsEarned, CASE WHEN today_sign.sign_in_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as todaySigned, sis.last_sign_in_date as lastSignInDate FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_profiles up ON u.user_id = up.user_id LEFT JOIN sign_in_status sis ON u.user_id = sis.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as monthly_sign_ins, SUM(points_reward) as points_earned FROM sign_in WHERE 1=1
AND YEAR(sign_in_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(sign_in_date) = #{month}
GROUP BY user_id ) monthly ON u.user_id = monthly.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, sign_in_id FROM sign_in WHERE DATE(sign_in_date) = CURDATE() ) today_sign ON u.user_id = today_sign.user_id WHERE 1=1
AND u.user_id = #{userId}
AND up.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%')
ORDER BY
totalSignIns
continuousDays
pointsEarned
sis.total_sign_ins
ASC
DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
